title: TranscriptChain
tagline: Transcript Nft is a platform which allows institutions such as universities, companies etc to issue out certificates and verify legitimacy of the certificate onchain.
description: Transcript Nft aims to bridge the disconnect in the labour market and also limit the manual method or processes associated with the academic sectors, Transcript nft allows for institutions to register and get unique ENS names through which they can mint out certificates to students based on how they choose(Academic calender) this nfts are then minted to the students and received into their wallets, students can share links to companies and this allows companies or potential employers to verify the authenticity of this certificates.This Nft certificates have unique information about each students specifically and it is soul bound
how_its_made:
This projects uses React as frontend, @polybase for data storage(users and university records), nodejs, @ethersjs for smart contract integration. @optimism for smart contract deployment. 
Express js for building of API's, integrating with the polybase protocol, contract interaction using ethers js.
